# SDD Skill

## Purpose

Support Specification-Driven Development with traceable requirements, design, tasks, and verification.

## Use this skill when

- creating or updating OpenSpec requirements
- translating behavior specs to implementation plans
- validating task completion against behavior scenarios

## Core rules

- write behavior-first scenarios (GIVEN/WHEN/THEN)
- keep implementation traceable to spec tasks
- update specs and docs in the same change set
